author: Speeded
body:
Hey guys toby here and im bringing my 1st complete build (back since 2013-2014 was the last time ive ever made a complete build)
Things are about to heat up in the dusty waters of the town of Natsu.

(Natsu is Summer in Japanese, im not a weeb btw kek, i just like the sound of it)

Images: https://imgur.com/a/wouXl
Loadout: https://imgur.com/DwS3PTL
Download: https://www.dropbox.com/home?preview=Natsu+%5BCTF%5D.zip
YML: (Idk how to make it so i need help)

This was my 1st time building a map but i think i did pretty well for not building anything for 2 years :)

replies.author: Speeded
replies.body:
Made some changes

  • Removed stairs and replaced them with blocks as steps at the middle, flag room and the side hall entrance.
  • Moved the flag position to the building connecting to the spawn tower so getting to it via sewers is alot harder (go right after the sewer exit and climb the back ladder, or go up the front staircase)
  • Loadout/Spawn Kit no longer has Golden Apples
  • Arrows no longer drop
  • Aesthetics around the broken building (sniper's nest)
